He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples ____.
The psalm calls for praise with the harp and the voice of melody.
The psalm says the LORD has kept his righteousness hidden from the nations.
Because the LORD reigns, what does the psalm say the peoples should do?
Among whom does the LORD sit enthroned?
Which prophet does the psalm name among those who called on the LORD's name?
Exalt the LORD our God. ____. He is Holy!
He spoke to them in ____. They kept his testimonies, the statute that he gave them.
You are a God who forgave them, although ____.
questions.answer: you took vengeance for their doings

questions.q: The psalm names Moses and Aaron among the LORD's priests.
The psalm says the LORD is great in Bethel.
How does the psalm tell us to serve the LORD?
The psalm says to enter the LORD's courts with what?
It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and ____.
For the LORD is good. His loving kindness endures forever, ____.
wrong: his glory over all the earth

questions.q: The psalm tells us to enter his gates with sacrifices.
